mapper.select: SELECT CoutConf3.관코드 As outputFlCode1, CoutConf3.항코드 As outputFlCode2, CoutConf3.목코드 As outputFlCode3, CoutConf3.코드분류 As codeType, RTrim(CoutConf1.관) As outputFlNm1, RTrim(CoutConf2.항) As outputFlNm2, RTrim(CoutConf3.목) As outputFlNm3, CoutConf3.순서 As seqNO, RTrim(CoutConf3.설명) As cnte FROM 지출관 CoutConf1, 지출항 CoutConf2, 지출목 CoutConf3 Where CoutConf3.관코드 = CoutConf1.관코드 AND CoutConf3.코드분류 = CoutConf1.코드분류 AND CoutConf3.관코드 = CoutConf2.관코드 AND CoutConf3.항코드 = CoutConf2.항코드 AND CoutConf3.코드분류 = CoutConf2.코드분류 AND CoutConf3.사용여부 >= '1' AND CoutConf3.코드분류 = #{codeGb}
